name: cognitive-operating-system
description: COS Graph Engine — Production-grade graph engine with CSR, WASM, pruning, observability, visualization, and deployment

scripts.asbuild: cd packages/wasm && npx asc assembly/index.ts --outFile build/optimized.wasm --optimizeLevel 3 --shrinkLevel 1 --exportRuntime
scripts.test:all: npx tsx scripts/run-tests.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-level1-diamond.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-level1-mutation.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-level3-consistency.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-level3-mutation.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-level7-compute.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-levels-12-19.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-pipeline-l45l6.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-pipeline-l891011.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-pipeline-l12131415.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-pipeline-l16171819.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-cli-visualizer.ts
scripts.test:observability: npx tsx packages/observability/tests/tracing.test.ts && npx tsx packages/observability/tests/collector.test.ts && npx tsx packages/observability/tests/profiler.test.ts && npx tsx packages/observability/tests/dashboard.test.ts
scripts.test:visualization: npx tsx packages/visualization/tests/svg-renderer.test.ts && npx tsx packages/visualization/tests/canvas-renderer.test.ts && npx tsx packages/visualization/tests/web-component.test.ts
scripts.test:l1: npx tsx scripts/test-level1-diamond.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-level1-mutation.ts
scripts.test:l3: npx tsx scripts/test-level3-consistency.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-level3-mutation.ts
scripts.test:mutation: npx tsx scripts/test-level1-mutation.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-level3-mutation.ts
scripts.benchmark:report: npx tsx scripts/benchmark-perf.ts && npx tsx scripts/generate-benchmark-report.ts
scripts.release: npm run build && echo 'Ready for npm publish'
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:graph && npm run publish:observability && npm run publish:visualization && npm run publish:wasm
